# Test data

Differential test inputs, run against both musql and C SQLite:

- `tcl/` — SQL mined from SQLite's own TCL test suite (`test/*.test` in
  <https://sqlite.org/src>). SQLite and its tests are in the public domain.
- `slt/` — files from sqllogictest (<https://sqlite.org/sqllogictest>), also in
  the public domain.
